name: Sinister Monkeys
summary:
Sinister Monkeys

Welcome to Sinister Monkeys, a psychological horror experience where every level pulls you deeper into madness.

You are a lone monkey—trapped inside a decaying mineshaft overrun by shadows and echoes of failed experiments. Something hunts you in the dark… and it learns with every encounter.

Face the terror alone, or team up with friends in co-op mode to survive what lurks beyond the next door. Each level is a test of instinct, courage, and sanity.

Uncover the truth. Escape the mineshaft
